description: keep git based? Partially open source? Like github? People come with their repos, we do the hosting people stay with us because it's convenient?

status.comment: Decided by Felix 2026-11-12: people own graphs (d4203221). Every graph is a repo on an Aimparency server; rights are per graph and enforced by that server; graphs link across servers by host URL. Git stays the storage and the history everywhere, so there is no second storage engine and no database. Still undecided: whether any part gets a proprietary license.
